themes.title: Crypto slips with tech futures
themes.summary: Bitcoin eased below $74,000 early Thursday as Nasdaq futures fell on reports that Nvidia's board was weighing CEO Jensen Huang's future (Yahoo Finance).

themes.title: ETF outflows widen
themes.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw about $300 million in net outflows on Nov. 11, a fifth straight day, while spot Ether ETFs lost about $145 million, mostly from BlackRock's ETHA (KuCoin).

themes.title: Stablecoin supply shrinks
themes.summary: Stablecoin supply fell about $14.2 billion over 30 days, the largest decline since 2022, according to Glassnode data cited by KuCoin.

themes.title: Rate-hike worries persist
themes.summary: Hot October inflation data has kept a December Fed hike in view, with October producer prices due Friday (KuCoin).

themes.title: Sentiment in fear
themes.summary: The Fear & Greed Index reads 28, down from 29, and daily RSI near 29.5 is in oversold territory (KuCoin).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Bitcoin fell about 0.5% and Ether about 1.2% over 24 hours, though 87% of the top coins posted gains in the same window (CoinCodex).

categories.name: Memecoins
categories.note: Pepe was among the weakest large coins, down about 14.5% over 24 hours (CoinCodex).

categories.name: Exchange and DeFi tokens
categories.note: OKB rose about 5% and Hyperliquid (HYPE) about 4% over 24 hours (KuCoin).

categories.name: Tokenization
categories.note: The OKX–ICE tokenized securities platform is scheduled to launch Nov. 23, and tokenized assets remain a key industry theme (KuCoin).

watch_list.why: Another inflation reading ahead of the Fed's December meeting, followed by remarks from Fed Vice Chair Philip Jefferson on Saturday (KuCoin).
Analysts flag $73.3K as a level to hold, with the recent low near $72.7K below and $74K–$74.8K as the area to reclaim (KuCoin).
A RAIN unlock of about $197 million (5.08% of supply) is due Thursday; a return to ETF inflows would signal buyers coming back (KuCoin).
